decisions.reason: Acceptance of the bulkier enclosure form does not change the existing stability, support, or anti-shifting requirements.
The source accepts the current machine form but does not change the base height, cup clearance, or edge-alignment requirement.
The enclosure-form decision does not alter bowl depth, capacity, or the acceptability of refilling.
Acceptance of the bulkier form does not change the machine's beige finish or green accents.
The possible future logo exploration does not establish a change to the placard text, position, orientation, or display sides.
The client accepts the current bulkier form without changing the DJ-turntable-inspired visual theme.
The enclosure-form acceptance does not change any splash-control target, speed condition, or mitigation option.
The decision about enclosure bulk does not alter the requirement to prevent liquid from reaching the electronics.
The client only expresses an intention to explore another logo and does not replace or cancel the current base graphics or typography.
The source does not change the support base's beige finish or its finish reference.
Acceptance of one enclosure-form detail does not necessarily change the system-layout deliverable or its recorded design maturity.
The bulkier enclosure form has no entailed effect on mixing smoothness, foam consistency, texture, or high-speed behavior.
